units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 7:2">Sabb. VII, 2</cite> <he>הַלָּשׁ</he> he who kneads (on the Sabbath). Y. ib. VII, 10ᵇ bot., a. fr. <he>חייב משום לָשׁ</he> is guilty of an act coming under the category of kneading (v. <cite ref="B00619"><he>בילוס</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Pesachim 30a">Pes. 30ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>אין לָשִׁין את וכ׳</he> you must not knead dough (of bread) with milk; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="L00325"><he>לוּשׁ</he></cite>, fr. <he>לוּשָׁה</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 9:13:6">Y. Sot. IX, 24ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>ל׳ בדבש וכ׳</he> kneaded with honey and cream (Bab.
<cite ref="Pesachim 35a:12">Pes. 35ᵃ</cite> <he>עיסה שנִילּוֹשָׁה וכ׳</he> dough kneaded with wine, oil or honey.
<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 5:2">Men. V, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Menachot 55a:10">55ᵃ</cite>) <he>נָלוֹשׁוֹת בפושרין</he> (Bab. ed. <he>נִילָּשׁוֹת</he>) must be kneaded with tepid water; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 959:20">Yalk. Prov. 959</cite> (etymol. of <cite ref="L00523"><he>לַיִשׁ</he></cite>) <he>שבשרו של אדם נלוש בשיניו</he> (not <he>בולש</he>) man’s flesh is kneaded between his (the lion’s) teeth; <cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 2">Ab. d’R. N. II</cite> Vers. ch. XLIII (ed. Schechter, p. 122) <he>שהכל נָלוֹשִׁין בפיו כמין בצק</he> (not <he>נעשין</he>).
